name: 招灾蛊
reference_role: 仅卡框、比例、可信光影材质，非身体和背景

evidence.chapter: chapter_0568｜第一百六十二节：人生为何早有悟（六千二大章）
evidence.excerpt: 它形如蚕茧。浑身灰白，只有小拇指大小，在水里载沉载浮。

design_boundary: 除证据摘录所锁外观之外，机位、材质细化、具体比例、自然解剖细节及环境布置为美术推断，不新增原著事实、不沿用游戏id转数。
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW 《问真》 Gu portrait collectible card, exact 5:7. Reference image ONLY supplies fine silver double-line rounded-corner frame with restrained curled corners and physical fantasy realism, not its creature, body, color, background or floor. One fully visible specific subject approximately 55-65% card width; clear subject hierarchy, physical sidelight, realistic textures, restful dreamlike space, complete frame on all sides. No text, title, number, rank, watermark, people, hands, halo, gratuitous gems or decorative symbols. Subject: ONE small grey-white silkworm COCOON-shaped Gu, little-finger scale, fine and unassuming, floating partially submerged at a calm dark water surface. A closed softly rounded oval cocoon with layered fine grey-white silk fibres across its surface and slight asymmetry, no head, eyes, legs, antennae or wings outside the cocoon. Delicate dense natural silk texture, faint dampness at the waterline, not a polished egg, stone pill, gemstone or exposed caterpillar. The cocoon lies slightly diagonal in the lower middle, occupies ~50% width, its complete silhouette clear. Still dark blue-grey water gently supports it, soft shallow reflections and a modest meniscus at contact, light grey upper cocoon contrasts naturally with dark below. Soft dim lateral daylight, spacious neutral water backdrop with subtle depth, no container, hand, petals or lake scene. No visible storm, lightning, disaster tableau, bursting cocoon, chrysalis face or cute eyes. Sacrifice is expressed by small plain fragile presence, not visual fireworks.

visible_facts: 单一灰白丝茧载浮于水面，丝网层次可辨，無肢体或脸
水线、倒影、侧光与体积关系清楚，无灾难特效
risks: 细丝外露与椭圆比例属设计，不声称具体品种
偏蚕茧而非裸蛹，符合本文锚点
